title: Sela Mor — Monochrome Minimal Personal Site

logo.specs: SVG; dark and light versions; square symbol for favicon
logo.note: Made for the site: src/components/Logo.tsx (mark + wordmark, works on black and white) and src/app/icon.svg (favicon)

typefaces.note: Mona Sans and Martian Mono via next/font/google (src/app/layout.tsx)

finalCopy.specs: Written in the recipe voice before layout; headlines ≤ 8 words
finalCopy.note: Written in the recipe voice: src/content/site.ts and the pages in src/app/

finalHeadlineCopy.specs: Short: 3–8 words each; written before layout
finalHeadlineCopy.note: Chapter words and statements in src/app/ and src/content/site.ts

punctuationImages.note: Not used: the photos are the works themselves (public/media/work-*.jpg, gallery-*.jpg, portrait.jpg, field-recording.jpg, stage.jpg)

filmForTheBand.usage: The scroll-controlled video band mid-page — its own film, not the first screen's media
filmForTheBand.specs: 1920×1080 min, 15–30 s, one continuous shot with no cuts and a slow steady camera move (it plays as visitors scroll); scripts/prepare-video.sh makes the scrub-ready encode
filmForTheBand.note: public/media/scrubReadyEncode.mp4 (desktop scrub), mobileVideoEncode.mp4 (phones), heroVideo.mp4; prepared with scripts/prepare-video.sh. The source is 10 s, shorter than the 15–30 s asked for

bandPoster.usage: Shown before the band’s film loads and on reduced motion
bandPoster.specs: First frame of the film, same crop

ambientSound.source: Pixabay Music / Freesound (check each file’s licence)
ambientSound.usage: The sound switch (AmbientSound) — off until the visitor turns it on
ambientSound.specs: One calm, seamless loop of 30–90 s; MP3 128 kbps, ≤ 1.5 MB; no voice or lyrics; quiet (about −18 LUFS)
